about_the_game:
Absurd Frog is a quirky and funny little game where you start as a tiny frog with a big appetite. Bugs, worms, and mice are just the beginning! The more you eat, the bigger and stronger you become, evolving into a giant frog!

Game Features:

  • Start Small – Begin as a humble frog and feast on insects and other small prey.

  • Explore a Living Forest – Venture through lush environments teeming with life, danger, and opportunity.

  • Avoid Poisonous Creatures – Not everything is on the menu. Some bites bite back!

  • Run From Predators – You're not top of the food chain, yet. Stay alert and stay alive.

  • Evolve & Dominate – Grow bigger and stronger. Morph into a colossal amphibian, towering over trees and even elephants!

  • Become the Apex Beast – Rule the ecosystem. Eat anything. Fear nothing. How absurdly massive can you become?
